name: Epoxy garage floors
summary: Garage floor coatings priced per square foot of grind and flake system, plus crack and pit repair.

items.label: Full grind and full-broadcast flake system, 3 coats
items.source: 1/80 h per sf grind (PREP_METHODS full-grind) + 3 coats x 1.12 waste / 220 sf/h (COATING_SYSTEMS full-flake); coating $2.85/sf + 0.2 lb/sf flake x $4.50/lb (index.html flakePricePerLb), both x 1.12 waste; 2-car 20x20 default (GARAGE_PRESETS, index.html)

items.label: Crack repair
items.source: 20 lf/h default crack rate (calc.mjs crackLfPerHour); crack fill $1.25/lf and 20 lf default (index.html)

items.label: Pit and spall fill
items.source: 15 sf/h default pit rate (calc.mjs pitSqFtPerHour); pit fill $4/sf (index.html); 0 sf default

items.label: Moisture-vapor barrier
items.source: moisture barrier $1.10/sf (index.html); the specialist adds no hours for it; unchecked by default

specialistModels: Solid, metallic and polyaspartic systems, etch vs grind vs shot-blast prep rates, vehicle cost per mile, and warnings for skipped grinds and starved flake.
